tasks.title: Unexpected query result fetched from an indexed column

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: DOUBLE ZEROFILL降序索引与负数字符串IN比较完整，修复仅公布26.7.0，无8.0分支边界。

test_spec.setup: t0(c0 DOUBLE ZEROFILL)，降序索引i0，INSERT DELAYED IGNORE0（记录8.0对DELAYED忽略警告）。
test_spec.steps: SELECT c0 FROM t0 WHERE IFNULL(-1123870957,'') IN(t0.c0)，另去索引对照。
test_spec.oracle: 负值不等于0，应空集；索引路径错误返回0作为异常，不以警告计bug。
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标8.0支持ZEROFILL/索引及该表达式，所有数据自包含。

comments.author: Edward Gilmore
comments.text:
Posted by developer:
 
Added the following note to the MySQL Server 26.7.0 release notes:

A SELECT using an indexed unsigned DOUBLE column could return the row
containing zero instead of an empty result when compared with a negative
constant expression having a string result type. 

The out-of-range conversion is now recognized as an
impossible range. 

Our thanks to Kun Qin for the contribution.
